Assalamu Alaikum I am a Hafiz Alhamdulillah, but I have problem pronouncing the Ra sound. There is a joint below the tip of my tongue, which makes my tongue tip-less and I cannot make the Ra sound. Whenever I try to pronounce Ra, the sound of Waw comes out. I have tried a lot of time when I was small, and when I was doing Hifz but it did not improve. Now since I am a Hafiz, I am usually asked to lead the prayer when the Imam is not present in the Masjid. I want to ask whether it is ok if I lead the prayer? I cannot even pronounce Allahu Akbar properly. The sound comes out as Allahu Akbaw, but people usually don't notice. And then there will be many more mistakes in Surah Fatihah. So is my prayer valid? And what about the prayer of those who are praying behind me? I heard one 'Alim say that if Takbeere Tahreema is not proper, then a person will not even enter into the prayer. It is as if he has not started the prayer at all. What should I do then? I cannot pronounce it properly. I hope Allah will accept my prayer because I am ma'zoor, but if I am leading the prayer, will the prayer of those behind me be valid? Jazakallah Khair 2924 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 42962 Country: India Title: Regarding Qasr Namaz Question: I am presently working at Muzaffarnagar and my permanent home is in Delhi, which is around 120 kms from Muzaffarnagar. Every Monday morning I come to Muzaffarnagar stay in a rented house and go back to Delhi in Saturday evening. Please clarify if qasr salah is applicable to me during my stay at Muzaffarnagar as I never intend to stay for more than 6 days. Answer ID: 42962 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 58/46/B=1434) In the question mentioned above, Muzaffarnagar is your place of residence (watan iqamah). In case you intend to stay there less than fifteen days you shall be musafir and you will have to offer qasr salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
